notes.title: You’re Never Alone on the Court
notes.content:
[h3]In Yooca’s Slam Attack, every second counts — and now, so does every cheer. The audience can drop [img src="https://a.slack-edge.com/production-standard-emoji-assets/14.0/google-medium/2764-fe0f.png"][/img] and [img src="https://a.slack-edge.com/production-standard-emoji-assets/14.0/google-medium/1f44d.png"][/img] to back you up, so whether it’s a clutch dunk or a quick toss, you’ll feel the support. Nobody plays this game alone — we’re all in it together!
[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45585319/84f19c56f7cb8910ba806222a321818773c2e479.gif"][/img][/p]
